frame: unrotated URDF base_link; +X forward, +Y left, +Z up
geometry_method: connected CAD solids; drive cylinders from support extents; caster cylinder fitted to lower rolling arc and swivel pivot from concentric mounting ring
chassis_contact: convex hull of CAD components excluding both drive wheels and complete caster assembly; chassis minimum Z exceeds 0.016 m

dynamics.mass_distribution: uniform density over CAD solids, normalized to total base assembly mass; COM and inertia derived from these solids
dynamics.caster_partition: estimated; fork retains residual mass, COM and inertia to conserve aggregate CAD properties
dynamics.traction_and_motor_limits: simulator estimates; not measured hardware ratings
dynamics.wheel_spin_resistance: finite-width cylinder contact patches; no additional point-contact torsional friction

scope: free-base manipulation/contact simulator; planar navigation model remains separate; no hardware calibration or full TAMP grasp admission
